Get W League Player

Source: R/wjbl.R
wjbl_player.Rd

Player profile: current team, names, bio and career notes, one row.

Endpoint: GET https://api.wjbl.01core.app/api/player

Usage

wjbl_player(player_id)

Arguments

player_id

Player id (player_id in wjbl_box_score or wjbl_roster): the person, stable across seasons, e.g. 9799.

Value

A wehoop_data tibble, one row per record; the columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py wjbl_player):

col_nametypedescription
player_idintegerPlayer id player_id (key space: W League persons, STABLE across seasons and teams). The player_id of /player and the pi= of the site's /player/detail?pi=; joins the play-by-play player_id1 / player_id2.
player_namecharacterName in Japanese, 'SURNAME GIVEN'.
player_name_encharacterName in romaji, uppercase, 'SURNAME GIVEN' ('OKAMOTO MIYUU').
player_furiganacharacterName reading in hiragana ((Japanese text)).
team_idintegerCurrent (or last) team: Franchise id team_id (key space: W League franchises, STABLE across seasons and sponsor renames: 13 = Toyota Antelopes, 12 = Denso Iris, 8 = ENEOS Sunflowers; all-star sides have their own ids, e.g. 591). The team_id of /team/roster and of the site's /team/roster/?team_id=. Not season_team_id.
season_team_namecharacterTeam name as registered for the season, in Japanese (company + nickname: Toyota Antelopes).
season_team_short_namecharacterShort team name for that season, Japanese (Toyota).
season_team_player_numbercharacterShirt number this season, a string.
team_logo_imagecharacterTeam logo path, relative to https://www.wjbl.org ('/static/images/base_team/...png' or '/assets/img/team/...png').
team_urlcharacterTeam's own website URL.
player_birthdaycharacterDate of birth 'YYYY/MM/DD' (public player bio).
player_nicknamecharacterNickname, Japanese.
player_positioncharacterPlaying position code ('PG', 'SG', 'SF', 'PF', 'C').
player_home_towncharacterHome prefecture, Japanese (Hokkaido).
player_heightcharacterHeight with unit, a string ('179cm').
player_weightcharacterWeight with unit, a string ('77kg').
player_height_cmintegerHeight in whole centimetres, parsed from player_height ('179cm').
player_weight_kgintegerWeight in whole kilograms, parsed from player_weight ('77kg').
player_affiliation_historycharacterCareer path, Japanese, (Japanese text)-separated (mini-basketball club (Japanese) junior high (Japanese) high school (Japanese) university (Japanese) team).
player_independent_flgintegerRetired flag (the site greys the team and hides the number): 1 = retired / no longer registered, 0 = active.
player_national_teamcharacterNational-team history, Japanese free text (Universiade).
player_awardscharacterAwards and honours, Japanese free text.
player_coach_historycharacterCoaching history (for players who became coaches); empty string in the sample.
player_coach_recordcharacterCoaching record; empty string in the sample.
player_picturecharacterPhoto path relative to https://www.wjbl.org.
player_wjbl_flginteger1 = a W League player (0 presumably for others; unverified).
player_rookieintegerRookie ((Japanese) icon): 1 = yes, 0 = no.
player_early_entryintegerEarly-entry player ((Japanese), a student who joined before graduating): 1 = yes, 0 = no.
player_foreign_national_flgintegerForeign national ((Japanese) icon): 1 = yes, 0 = no.
player_naturalized_flgintegerNaturalised player ((Japanese) icon): 1 = yes, 0 = no.
player_appealcharacterSelf-introduction text; empty string in the sample.
player_championshipscharacterChampionships text; empty string in the sample.
player_urlcharacterPersonal website URL; empty string in the sample.
player_facebook_urlcharacterFacebook URL; empty string in the sample.
player_twitter_urlcharacterX (Twitter) URL; empty string in the sample.
player_instagram_urlcharacterInstagram URL; empty string in the sample.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in wjbl_leagues().

 wjbl_player(player_id = 9799)
